title: Gaze of Heavenly Dao
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was caught in the moment of choice, that voice rang out again, carrying the hunger of ten thousand years of dormancy: "You and I are birds of the same fate. Why not dance the final move of this chess game with me?"

text.content: The moment Chen Ji succeeded in rewriting, that pair of sky-covering great eyes slowly opened in the Void—a being beyond the Heavenly Dao's Eye, older and more terrifying. In an instant, heaven and earth lost their colors, stars trembled, as if the entire world was prostrating itself before this gaze. Chen Ji felt an invisible pressure surge like a tide, nearly crushing his soul.

Those eyes were deep as an abyss, with countless stars' birth and death flowing within the pupils. Each star's fall carried a silent sigh. Ten thousand years of time in those eyes was but a snap of fingers; ten thousand years of struggle in the depths of those pupils was merely an unfinished nightmare. Chen Ji wished to look away, yet discovered his gaze had been locked in place, like a moth drawn to flame, unable to free itself.

"Ant-like creature, how dare you touch the forbidden door." A voice rang from the Void, ancient and authoritative, devoid of any emotion, yet causing Chen Ji's soul to tremble with waves of cold fear. This voice seemed to come from the very source of the universe, or perhaps from the other end of the river of time. Each word weighed like a thousand catties, pressing down on Chen Ji until he could barely breathe.

dialogue.content: "You think the Heavenly Dao's Eye is the master of this realm? How laughable." The voice carried the mockery of ten thousand years. "That is merely the first chess game laid out by a higher existence, and I... am the prisoner trapped beneath the chessboard."

text.content: Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record within his body suddenly shudder violently. The runes on the fragment flickered frantically, as if responding to some ancient summoning. Mo Xiansheng's blurred figure on the first page rippled intensely, seemingly warning him of something, yet unable to speak. At that moment, Chen Ji finally understood—the Tianji Record in his hands was never any heavenly treasure.

"Ten thousand years ago, I attempted to break the chess game of higher realms and challenge the authority of that existence." The voice continued, carrying a hint of bitter laughter. "I failed. My physical body was sealed within the Heavenly Dao's origin, my divine soul was sliced into countless fragments, scattered across every corner of this realm. And the fragment in your hands... is merely a wisp of my remnant will."

Tidal waves crashed in Chen Ji's heart. Mo Xiansheng, the Tianji Record fragment, his own adventures along the way... everything connected at this moment, weaving into a web beyond his imagination. He was not the chosen one—he was the selected chess piece, a part of this chess game from the very beginning. Ironic, indeed, that this self-proclaimed master of schemes was merely a manipulated piece in an even greater game.

dialogue.content: "The Tianji Record fragment in your body, I deliberately left as a lure. Without it, you would be nothing but a useless mortal; with it, you could reach where you are today." The voice was terrifyingly calm. "You think you're the protagonist? No, you are the key tool for my escape, the final puzzle piece before the sacrifice is complete."

text.content: Those pair of sky-covering great eyes slowly drew near, the stars within the pupils spinning愈发剧烈, as if they would suck Chen Ji's very soul into them. Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value draining frantically—that was a far more terrifying erosion than any attack. The originally blurred text on the Tianji Record suddenly became clear—it was not a record of prophetic arts, but a remnant of sealing techniques.

"The Heavenly Dao's Eye is merely a remnant shadow I left when challenging that existence of old. The true enemy lies above the Heavenly Dao." The voice carried ten thousand years of undying hatred. "It sealed me within the Heavenly Dao's origin, leaving me unable to live or die by my own will. Every time someone uses the Tianji Record, they are helping me break the chains of the seal... and you are the final step."

choice.prompt: Facing this defeated warrior from ten thousand years ago, Chen Ji had to make a choice—would he destroy this seal, utilize it, or make a deal with this terrifying existence?

choices.description: Fight this existence to the bitter end, even if it is a warrior from ten thousand years ago, even if its power far exceeds imagination. Fate lies in one's own hands—never the tool of any existence.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independence, not be manipulated by any existence
choices.risk_hint: Success probability extremely low, but failure may not necessarily be a dead end

text.content: Chen Ji violently urged all the remaining power within the Tianji Record fragment, and said with a cold smile: "You failed challenging the higher existence ten thousand years ago, and now you expect me to follow your footsteps? How ridiculous!" His voice trembled, but his eyes had never been more resolute.

choices.description: Since this existence needs him to complete the sacrifice, he would turn the tables—seeking maximum benefit for himself during the sealing process. What if he was making a deal with the tiger? As long as the stakes were high enough, even demons could be tamed.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain power far beyond current realm
choices.risk_hint: May be counterattacked, reduced to an even deeper chess piece

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the fear in his heart and put on a composed smile: "Since the predecessor has been laying plans for ten thousand years, surely you will not mistreat this chess piece of yours. I wonder what this junior can gain from this?" He thought to himself: Want to use me? Then let's see whose acting skills are better.

choices.description: This existence wanted to use him for the sacrifice, but he could also take this opportunity to make some kind of deal with this ancient existence. Each takes what they need, neither owes the other—as long as the terms are right, nothing is impossible.
choices.visible_reward: Gain part of this existence's legacy and protection
choices.risk_hint: The deal may have traps hidden within

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, staring directly at those colossal eyes that seemed to cover the heavens: 'Senior needs me to complete the sacrifice, but after the sacrifice, what can I gain? I don't believe in empty promises.' His voice was steady, as if discussing an ordinary transaction.

Those heaven-covering eyes paused for a moment, as if examining this ant who dared to bargain with it. A moment later, a low laugh rang out from the void, carrying a hint of surprise and appreciation: 'Interesting, the first mortal in ten thousand years to dare negotiate terms with me. What do you want?'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji felt the oppressive force slightly loosen, and he quickly organized his thoughts. 'I need to know the complete truth—about the origin of the Tianji Record, about my sister Chen Nian's whereabouts, about the true identity of that higher existence.' He paused. 'And how to escape the fate of being a chess piece.'

text.content: 'Truth?' The voice carried a hint of playfulness. 'The more you know, the deeper you sink. Ten thousand years ago, I knew too much, and that's how I ended up in this state.' The stars in those colossal eyes suddenly accelerated their rotation, and the entire space trembled. 'But since you want to know... I can tell you part of it.'

Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment trembling intensely again. Mo Xiansheng's blurry figure suddenly became clearer, seemingly conveying something. Chen Ji's heart stirred as he suddenly remembered—every time the Tianji Record foresaw a future involving Chen Nian, the image was blurred. Now he understood: that wasn't Chen Nian's ability, but interference from a higher existence.

choice.prompt: After learning part of the truth, Chen Ji needed to make a more specific decision—whether to continue digging deeper into the truth or to first ensure his own safety?

choices.description: Since we've come this far, all mysteries must be unraveled. Chen Nian's whereabouts, the secrets of the Tianji Record, the weaknesses of that higher existence... He wanted to know everything to truly control his own fate.
choices.visible_reward: Gain key intelligence and possibly find a way to break the situation
choices.risk_hint: Knowing too much could result in being eliminated

text.content: 'Where is my sister?' Chen Ji's voice turned icy cold. 'What does the Holy Sect mean by 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'? You better tell me everything, otherwise this sacrifice... no one will get what they want.'

choices.description: The truth can be investigated slowly, but life only comes once. First find a way to gain some actual benefits from this existence, ensuring he doesn't lose too badly in this deal.
choices.visible_reward: Gain substantial strength improvement or protection
choices.risk_hint: May be looked down upon by the other party, losing bargaining chips

text.content: 'Before discussing any terms, I need some assurance.' Chen Ji's voice was neither servile nor overbearing. 'For example... can you give me something practical first? Let me know that collaborating with you is worthwhile.'

choices.description: Before making the final decision, first probe this existence's bottom line and true intentions. Understanding how much it truly needs him is the only way to take the initiative in negotiations.
choices.visible_reward: Understand the other party's true needs, gain negotiating advantage

text.content: "Venerable One, you've been scheming for ten thousand years. Surely I'm not your only option?" Chen Ji probed. "I want to know, besides me, are there other pieces? Why did you choose this worthless wretch?"

That sky-obscuring giant eye narrowed slightly, the stars within its pupil suddenly frozen, as if the entire space had solidified in this moment. Chen Ji felt an unprecedented pressure surge toward him—ten thousand years of accumulated authority and fury. A moment later, the pressure receded like a tide, replaced by a low, dark laughter.

dialogue.content: "Who do you think you're speaking to?" The voice carried the chill of ten thousand years'沉淀. "I laid plans for ten millennia, not to play some Q&A game with you. The sacrifice must be completed—this is unchangeable. As for your question..." A strange gleam flashed in that massive eye. "Perhaps when you become the sacrificial offering, you'll understand."

text.content: Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record within him suddenly blaze with heat, the once-gentle runes erupting into violent fury, as if something was trying to break free. Simultaneously, countless images flashed through his mind—Chen Nian trapped in endless darkness, the tragic destruction of Tianqing Sect, and a vague, transcendent presence overlooking all of this.

"That was... a higher existence?" Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly. The being in those visions defied all description—it was neither eye nor human form, but the very will of Heavenly Dao itself, the origin of all rules, an absolute authority beyond challenge or question. And now he finally understood—he was not merely a piece on the chessboard, but part of the board itself.

choice.prompt: Facing this unimaginable existence, Chen Ji realized his fate was inextricably bound to it. In this final moment, he must make the ultimate choice—

choices.description: Even in death, he would die with dignity. He would never be a sacrifice to any being, even if the opponent transcended Heavenly Dao. Even if he perished here today, he would leave an indelible wound on this existence.

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully activated all power within him, roaring: "You want to use me as a sacrifice? Dream on!" The Tianji Record Fragment erupted with dazzling light—a self-destructive counterattack, the final cry of the weak in their darkest hour.

choices.description: The situation overrides all else. Since resistance is impossible, negotiate the best terms. Agree to its demands, but carve out maximum advantage in the details. When one's wings are strong, settle the score later.
choices.visible_reward: Gain a breathing space, and the promised protection of that existence
choices.risk_hint: Risk falling into a deeper trap

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, and when he opened them again, they had returned to their usual depth and composure: "Very well, I agree. But I have one condition—I must see my sister with my own eyes, confirm she's safe. Otherwise... this deal is void."

choices.description: Never speak in absolutes, never give a clear answer. Bury countless implications in his words, leave himself ample room to retreat. Since this is a ten-thousand-year chess game, there must be a way to break it—he needs time, information, to find that fatal flaw.
choices.risk_hint: risk being seen through by the opponent

text.content: Chen Ji revealed a meaningful smile: "Elder is right, I do need your help. But before making a decision, I still want to confirm some things... For example, what exactly is the relationship between the Eye of Heavenly Ways and you? And when do you plan to tell me?"

The moment Chen Ji made his choice, the entire space violently trembled. That sky-covering giant eye suddenly contracted, the stars within the pupil all extinguished, transforming into a void of darkness. A presence incomparably more terrifying than before surged from the depths of the Void—the true master behind the Eye of Heavenly Ways, finally noticed this place.

"Do you think you can escape?" That aged voice carried terror for the first time, "It has come... faster than I anticipated!" That sky-covering giant eye flickered frantically, as if in some kind of resistance. At the same time, Chen Ji felt all the runes on the Tianji Record Fragment light up, and Mo Xiansheng's blurry figure spoke aloud for the first time: "Chen Ji, it's not too late to make a choice—cooperate with me to break this ten-thousand-year prison, or... become a piece on the chessboard forever?"
